job.description: One literal job label value, limited to 1-128 UTF-8 bytes with no control characters.

purpose: Observe the selected job's returned log entries.
limitations: Returned log entries do not establish service health or complete event coverage.
Log retention, sampling, job-label reuse and incomplete returned data can limit the observation.
Requested lines do not prove returned coverage; empty results are not zero or an all-clear.
